idea-plugin.name: i18n fr-CA Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the France-French and left-over English lines in your fr-CA locale file before an OQLF complaint does.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → i18n fr-CA Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 9 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/i18n-fr-ca-bill96-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/i18n-fr-ca-bill96-lint

action.text: i18n fr-CA Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run i18n fr-CA Lint on the file in the editor
